profile.headline: Full Stack Developer
profile.summary: Hi! My name's Jeslyn and I’m a self-taught software developer with a passion for developing beautiful, user-friendly applications. Since I started my career in 2017, programming has become a beloved pastime and practice for me. During this time, I’ve developed an ethic of rapidly building clean, reusable, and high-quality code as I strive to keep with current best practices. I enjoy working on solo work as well as collaborative projects, as long as I get to code. ☕️

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Synergy is a premier information technology services provider serving U.S. federal agencies. At Synergy, I develop and maintain mission-critical web applications for the U.S. Department of Agriculture, primarily supporting the Forest Service.

- Full-Stack Development: Designed and implemented scalable features from the C# backend to the Angular frontend, ensuring optimal performance, security, and user experience.

- Architectural Design: Contributed to system architecture, analyzing and improving existing workflows while developing new, efficient solutions for complex business requirements.

- Project Management: Independently managed four separate projects, acting as the sole developer for two while collaborating within small teams on the others, improving legacy systems, and integrating modern technologies.

- Frontend Engineering: Built dynamic, responsive UI components with Angular, Material, and Bootstrap, ensuring high accessibility standards and seamless cross-browser and mobile compatibility.

- Backend & API Development: Developed and maintained RESTful services, working with C#, .NET, and SQL Server to enhance data integrity and optimize system performance.

- Security & Compliance: Integrated high-security authentication protocols, adhering to strict government standards and implementing dynamically manageable roles for administrators.

- Issue Resolution & Support: Investigated and resolved critical live application issues, ensuring minimal downtime and maintaining seamless user experience.

- Collaboration & Documentation: Worked closely with Business Analysts and clients to refine procedures, enhance system functionality, and document technical updates for long-term maintainability.
positions.insights: Skills: AngularJS · Angular · TypeScript · Full-Stack Development · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · .NET · Microsoft SQL Server · Angular Material · JIRA · Production Experience · JavaScript · Entity Framework · jQuery · Bootstrap · C#

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.locationName: San Antonio, Texas, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Xerox Business Solutions Southwest provides cutting-edge technology, document management solutions, and customized support to optimize business performance. At Xerox, I independently led multiple projects, collaborating directly with clients to design and implement solutions that streamlined workflows and improved operational efficiency.

- Project Leadership & Client Collaboration: Independently managed projects from inception to deployment, gathering functional requirements, presenting UI designs, and refining software behavior to align with client goals.

- Ticketing System Development: Designed and built a new ticketing system with Vue.js, featuring email notifications, automated workflows, and an intuitive interface that adapted to various team processes.

- Mentorship & Team Support: Assisted junior developers by providing guidance, introducing best practices, and promoting strategic refactoring processes to enhance code maintainability.

- Frontend Development: Utilized Vue.js and Kendo UI to rapidly develop new feature sets, reports, and views while maintaining design consistency with existing UI patterns.

- High-Performance Reporting: Developed and optimized SQL queries to ensure efficient reporting while integrating enhancements with minimal database design modifications.

- API & Backend Enhancements: Improved and expanded existing APIs using ORMLite and SQL, enhancing data accessibility and streamlining user interactions.

- Database Management: Maintained and updated relational databases using Microsoft SQL Server to support application scalability and data integrity.
positions.insights: Skills: Github · ASP.NET MVC · Node.js · Kendo · Vue.js · Full-Stack Development · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Microsoft SQL Server · MongoDB · Front-End Development · Production Experience · Back-End Web Development · JavaScript · jQuery · Bootstrap · C#

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Tresta is a powerful virtual phone application that enables businesses to manage phone numbers, auto-attendants, and team communication from any device. At Tresta, I played a key role in developing and enhancing mobile and web applications to improve the user experience and expand platform capabilities.

- Mobile & Web Development: Built and maintained cross-platform applications for iOS and Android using React Native, ensuring a seamless and modern user experience.

- Frontend Engineering: Developed intuitive UI components with HTML, SASS, JavaScript, and TypeScript and ReactNative optimizing for cross-browser compatibility and accessibility.

- Feature Development: Designed and implemented new functionalities for an online SMS messaging platform, improving communication workflows for business users.

- API & Backend Development: Expanded and optimized RESTful APIs, integrating internal and third-party systems using C#, Entity Framework, and MySQL.

- Database Management: Maintained and updated relational databases in AWS MySQL Server, implementing Entity Framework migrations to support new features.

- System Reliability & Support: Participated in an on-call rotation, troubleshooting system emergencies, performing minor server reboots, and assisting with customer support tickets as needed.

- Quality Assurance Collaboration: Worked closely with QA teams to ensure a stable, consistent UI/UX across multiple browsers and devices, refining user flows and fixing bugs.

- Agile & Team Contributions: Followed scrum methodologies, actively participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and peer code reviews to uphold team standards and maintain project consistency.

- Technical Documentation: Authored and maintained documentation on developer processes, team coding standards, and internal how-to guides.

positions.title: Applications & Web Developer
positions.description:
IAPMO develops and adapts plumbing, mechanical, and energy codes to meet jurisdictional needs across North America and beyond. As a founding developer, I played a key role in designing and implementing a multi-tiered .NET enterprise web application to modernize business processes and improve operational efficiency.

- Full-Stack Development: Designed and developed features from the data layer to the presentation layer, ensuring seamless integration and system scalability.

- API & Backend Engineering: Built RESTful APIs using WebAPI and MVC frameworks, implementing C#-based validation and processing to deliver structured JSON responses.

- Dynamic UI Development: Created reusable AngularJS components with dynamic views tailored to user permissions, enhancing accessibility and maintainability.

- Automated Document Processing: Implemented Microsoft Office Interop and ClosedXML for Excel automation, enabling seamless data importing, styling, and multi-format document generation.

- Background Job Processing: Developed scheduled tasks with SignalR, JSON serialization/deserialization, dynamic server-side DataTables, and integrated user notes, ensuring efficient data handling and retrieval.

- Database Architecture: Designed and managed relational databases in SQL Server, utilizing Entity Framework's Code First approach, LINQ for efficient data access, and AutoMapper for streamlined object mapping.

- Agile Collaboration: Worked closely with cross-functional teams, contributing to Agile Scrum workflows, debugging issues, and maintaining comprehensive documentation.

- This role allowed me to establish foundational architecture for a large-scale enterprise application while developing critical backend systems, APIs, and dynamic front-end components.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
As a freelance web developer, I collaborated with remote clients to bring their web applications to life, handling both front-end and back-end development while ensuring seamless user experiences.

- Full-Stack Development: Built custom MVC web applications using AngularJS, Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB, integrating third-party APIs to enhance functionality.

- Client Collaboration: Gathered and analyzed requirements, designed UI mockups, and iterated closely with clients to ensure the final product met their vision.

- UI/UX Design: Designed and implemented responsive themes using HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, and JavaScript, delivering visually appealing and user-friendly interfaces.

- Project Management: Maintained clear communication with clients through weekly updates, ensuring alignment on development progress and feature implementation.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Laso Concepts is a platform designed to connect healthcare institutions, patients, and support teams. As part of the team, I contributed to building its MVP—a mobile-responsive single-page application with robust user management and communication features.

- Data Optimization: Utilized MongoDB aggregation pipelines to efficiently join denormalized data, minimizing server round trips and improving query performance.

- Backend Development: Implemented Express.js routing stacks to enforce authentication, model validation, and authorization, ensuring security and data integrity.

- Feature Development: Rapidly prototyped and deployed full-stack features, leveraging RESTful APIs to support dynamic user interactions.

- Administrative Tools: Built an administrative data management interface, allowing manual adjustments to user accounts and user-generated content.

- Code Standards & Best Practices: Maintained adherence to API design principles, ES6 coding conventions, CSS methodologies, and security best practices.

- Agile Collaboration: Participated in daily scrums, weekly client demos, peer code reviews, technical presentations, and product ideation sessions to refine platform features.

positions.title: Marketing Assistant/Internal Communications Coordinator
positions.description:
Prime Healthcare is a nationally recognized health system operating 45 hospitals and over 300 outpatient locations across 14 states. During my time at Prime Healthcare, I gained valuable experience in web management, digital communication, and cross-functional collaboration—skills that later influenced my transition into software development.

- Web Development & Management: Led the redesign and maintenance of over 40 websites, ensuring optimized content structure, accessibility, and user experience.

- Content Management & Automation: Maintained SharePoint sites and internal CMS platforms to streamline information sharing and improve team collaboration.

- Technical Collaboration: Worked closely with executives to implement digital marketing, communication, and public relations strategies using various technologies.

- Recognition & Achievements: Awarded Employee of the Year in 2016 for outstanding contributions to digital initiatives and process improvements.

- This role provided me with foundational technical and communication skills that seamlessly transitioned into my career as a software developer, reinforcing my ability to bridge the gap between technical teams and business objectives.

positions.title: Admissions Counselor
positions.description:
Utilizing various technologies, such as Oracle's BANNER,  to review student applications while overseeing the entire process from initial recruitment to the student's final academic decision. 
- Supervised and managed the department's 12 student workers, overseeing their work, and creating projects for them as well. 
-  Communicate with students, parents, enrollment counselors, advisors, and departments
- Generated reports of applicant data

positions.title: Admissions Department Secretary
positions.description: Leveraging several technologies, processed transcripts, test scores, managed applications and maintained internal databases with current information.

During my time at Prime Healthcare, I gained valuable experience in web management, digital communication, and cross-functional collaboration—skills that later influenced my transition into software development.

- Web Development & Management: Led the redesign and maintenance of over 40 websites, ensuring optimized content structure, accessibility, and user experience.

- Content Management & Automation: Maintained SharePoint sites and internal CMS platforms to streamline information sharing and improve team collaboration.

- Technical Collaboration: Worked closely with executives to implement digital marketing, communication, and public relations strategies using various technologies.

- Recognition & Achievements: Awarded Employee of the Year in 2016 for outstanding contributions to digital initiatives and process improvements.

- This role provided me with foundational technical and communication skills that seamlessly transitioned into my career as a software developer, reinforcing my ability to bridge the gap between technical teams and business objectives.

positions.title: Admissions Counselor
positions.description:
Utilizing various technologies, such as Oracle's BANNER,  to review student applications while overseeing the entire process from initial recruitment to the student's final academic decision. 
- Supervised and managed the department's 12 student workers, overseeing their work, and creating projects for them as well. 
-  Communicate with students, parents, enrollment counselors, advisors, and departments
- Generated reports of applicant data

positions.title: Admissions Department Secretary
positions.description: Leveraging several technologies, processed transcripts, test scores, managed applications and maintained internal databases with current information.
